# Amperity

> Amperity helps your brand build accurate customer profiles that makes your customer data usable to your entire business.

- [User guides](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-user.txt): llms.txt file for Amperity user guides.
- [Operators guide](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-operator.txt): llms.txt file for Amperity operators guide.
- [Connections: Operators](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-connections-operator.txt): llms.txt file for configuring Amperity connections.
- [Connections: Users](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-connections-user.txt): llms.txt file for using Amperity connections.
- [API](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-api.txt): llms.txt file for Amperity APIs.
- [Reference](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-reference.txt): llms.txt file for Amperity reference docs.
- [Reference: Attributes](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-reference-attributes.txt): llms.txt file for Amperity attributes reference docs.
- [Reference: Data tables](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-tables.txt): llms.txt file for data tables.
- [Reference: Semantics](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-semantics.txt): llms.txt file for semantics.
- [Reference: Presto SQL](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-sql-presto.txt): llms.txt file for Presto SQL.
- [Reference: Spark SQL](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-sql-spark.txt): llms.txt file for Spark SQL.
- [Guided setup](https://docs.amperity.com/llms-guides.txt): llms.txt file for guided setup.
